extraction_notes: The datasheet identifies MMBT5401 as a PNP transistor; signed currents and voltages retain the datasheet's negative polarity.
The hFE rows at IC = -1 mA, -10 mA, and -50 mA are guaranteed minimums. The -10 mA maximum of 300 is represented as a separate maximum gain point.

The Ta = 25 degC hFE curve in Fig. 2 and representative curves in Figs. 1, 3, 4, 5, and 6 were manually digitized from the supplied plots. Digitized points are approximate plot readings at sampled locations and were not interpolated.
No numeric Cobo or Cib table row is supplied. cobo and cibo are null; Fig. 6 is represented as separate digitized Cib and Cob curves with capacitance converted from pF to F.
The fT entry is a guaranteed minimum of 100 MHz at IC = -10 mA, VCE = -5.0 V, and f = 30 MHz.
VCEO is recorded from the -150 V minimum collector-emitter breakdown row at IC = -1.0 mA and IB = 0.
